question: Which state government launched an intensive statewide vaccination drive against Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) starting 1 March 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of Gujarat has initiated an intensive statewide vaccination campaign starting 1 March 2026 to combat Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) and protect the livelihoods of dairy farmers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The vaccination drive will continue until 15 April 2026, targeting livestock health across the state under the National Animal Disease Control Programme (NADCP).**
 
• To maintain immunity, vaccination drives are conducted by the state twice every year, specifically during the months of March and September.
 
• Animals are being identified through ear-tagging, with all data being uploaded to the Information Network for Animal Productivity and Health (INAPH) portal for digital monitoring.
 
• Gujarat__
 __
 
• Capital - Gandhinagar
 
• Chief Minister - Bhupendrabhai Patel
 
• Governor - Acharya Devvrat
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)__

 __
 
• Nature of Infection: It is a highly contagious viral infection that primarily affects cloven-hoofed animals such as cattle, buffaloes, sheep, and goats.
 
• Clinical Symptoms: Affected livestock typically exhibit fever, mouth ulcers, and excessive salivation.
 
• Economic Consequences: The disease leads to a sharp decline in milk production and overall productivity, resulting in significant financial losses for the dairy sector.
 
 
 
• National Animal Disease Control Programme (NADCP)__
 __
 
• Overview: It is a flagship scheme launched by the central government aimed at controlling Foot & Mouth Disease and Brucellosis by vaccinating the livestock population.
 
 
 
• INAPH Portal__
 
 
• Overview: The Information Network for Animal Productivity and Health (INAPH) is a digital platform used to track the health, breeding, and nutritional data of individual animals, facilitated through unique ear-tagging.
